_comment: Rapo college dataset — Greenfield University students and faculty, realistic academic-year events.

events.title: Freshers' Orientation — Team Ice-Breakers
events.description: Welcome to Greenfield University! New students are grouped into small mixed-department teams for a structured half-day of campus tours, icebreaker challenges, and introductions to student clubs. Teams stay together for the afternoon social.
events.location: GFU Main Quad & Student Union, Building A

events.title: IntraCollege Hackathon — Autumn 2026
events.description: 48-hour hackathon for all GFU students. Build something real: a web app, ML model, hardware prototype, or open-source tool. Teams are formed across departments — every team must include at least one CS and one non-CS student. Top 3 teams get lab credits and intern referrals.

events.title: IEEE Circuit Design Challenge
events.description: Annual circuit design and prototyping competition run by the GFU IEEE Student Chapter. Teams design, simulate, and physically build a working circuit to meet a given spec — this year: low-power IoT sensor node. Oscilloscopes, PCB mills, and component kits provided.

events.title: AI Research Reading Group — Autumn Sprint
events.description: Six-week peer reading group: students team up to study, present, and critically discuss a set of landmark AI/ML papers (transformers, diffusion models, RL foundations). Each team presents one paper and writes a group critique. Open to CS, Maths, and Data Science students.

events.title: Intercollege Cultural Fest — GFU Ensemble
events.description: GFU's flagship cultural event. Students form performing arts ensembles across departments — music, dance, drama, spoken word. Each ensemble rehearses for three weeks and performs on fest night. All genres welcome; no prior experience required.

events.title: Final Year Capstone Project Expo
events.description: 4th-year students present their capstone projects to a panel of faculty and industry guests. Students are grouped into presentation slots by project theme. Each slot has 4 teams who present back-to-back and cross-evaluate each other's work.

events.title: Sports Day — Team Events
events.description: Annual GFU Sports Day. Students register as individuals and are grouped into mixed-department teams for relay races, tug-of-war, cricket, and football. Teams are balanced by department and year to keep things fair and fun.
